name: Weapon Edge Specular Rim Light
purpose: Emphasize weapon silhouette and metallic skin reflections during ADS or trigger pull.
required_visual_conditions: Weapon model clearly visible in lower right/center of first-person view.
required_source_footage: First-person POV capture with weapon viewmodel enabled.
recommended_color_palette: Matches weapon skin dominant secondary tone (#e2e8f0 or #f59e0b).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> RectangleMask1 (Viewmodel ROI) -> HighPassFilter1 -> BrightnessContrast1 (Gain: 1.4) -> Merge1 (Add) -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: HighPass filter isolates metallic edges on rifle, BrightnessContrast amplifies edge glints, add-merged onto original.
qa_procedure: Ensure crosshair area is excluded from mask; skin decals must not distort.
